subject: computer-science
title: Data Representation: Convert & Calculate
welcome_lead: Roll up your sleeves — let's convert numbers between bases.
meta_desc: GCSE Computer Science adventure on converting binary, denary and hex with worked examples.
final_note: You're now fluent across binary, denary and hex.

concepts.def: Base-16, a shorthand for binary (0–9, A–F).
A bit is one binary digit; 8 bits make a byte.
ASCII and Unicode represent text as binary codes.
Images stored as pixels with a colour depth.
Sound sampled at a rate and bit depth to store digitally.

walkthroughs.body_html: Split into nibbles: 1010 1100. Left nibble 1010 = 10 = A. Right nibble 1100 = 12 = C. So 1010 1100 = AC.

mcqs.q: What is hex A in denary?
Which item is removed first from a stack?
options: Any item, randomly.
The first one added (FIFO).
11 (counting the 1s).
The most recently added (top) - LIFO.

mcqs.q: What is the denary value of binary 10110?
options: Any item, randomly.
11 (counting the 1s).
10110 (treating it as a denary number).

mcqs.q: What happens when 11111111 + 1 is computed in an 8-bit register?
options: It just becomes 100000000 normally.
The computer crashes.
Any item, randomly.
Overflow - the result requires 9 bits but only 8 are available.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Column values”?
options: Two hex digits represent one byte.
8-bit unsigned binary covers 0 to 255.
Least significant bit — the rightmost bit.
Place values: 128 64 32 16 8 4 2 1 in 8-bit.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “MSB”?
options: Place values: 128 64 32 16 8 4 2 1 in 8-bit.
When a number exceeds the bits available to store it.
Most significant bit — the leftmost bit.
Least significant bit — the rightmost bit.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Hex pair”?
options: Most significant bit — the leftmost bit.
Least significant bit — the rightmost bit.
Two hex digits represent one byte.
Place values: 128 64 32 16 8 4 2 1 in 8-bit.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “LSB”?
options: When a number exceeds the bits available to store it.
Two hex digits represent one byte.
Least significant bit — the rightmost bit.
Most significant bit — the leftmost bit.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Overflow”?
options: Most significant bit — the leftmost bit.
Place values: 128 64 32 16 8 4 2 1 in 8-bit.
When a number exceeds the bits available to store it.
Least significant bit — the rightmost bit.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Range”?
options: 8-bit unsigned binary covers 0 to 255.
Place values: 128 64 32 16 8 4 2 1 in 8-bit.
When a number exceeds the bits available to store it.
Most significant bit — the leftmost bit.
